title: Bounded constructible complexes under a proper direct image
statement:
Let $b:Y\to S$ be proper
between finite-type $k$-schemes, with the finite coefficients of
[sbc-def-coefficient-conventions].
For an ordinary derived
complex $K\in\hyperref[def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]{D^b_c(Y,\Lambda)}$,
its derived direct image
$Rb_*K$ belongs to $D^b_c(S,\Lambda)$.

proof.text: First prove the source-library finite-stalk version in AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.boundedConstructible_rightDerivedLowerStar_of_isProper. A finite coefficient ring is torsion as an additive group. Apply [lem-kun-0f10] to b with the compatible structure maps b followed by aS and aS. This gives an integer d such that Rb_*(F[0]) has no cohomology above d, uniformly in all module sheaves F. The right derived functor preserves the lower bound zero. For constructible F, [thm-fin-proper-constructibility-complete] gives constructibility of all its higher direct images. Thus Rb_*(F[0]) is bounded constructible.

Constructible sheaves form a Serre subcategory by [thm-constructible-serre]. The existing proved boundedConstructible_obj_of_forall_singleFunctor lemma uses finite truncation triangles and closure of bounded constructible objects under shifts and extensions. Apply it to the triangulated derived direct-image functor and the result of step 1, obtaining the source-library bounded-complex assertion.

Prove the exact project statement attached to this node. If the target is empty, every cohomology sheaf on its etale site is zero, so the conclusion holds with support interval [0,0]. Otherwise a positive coefficient annihilator invertible on the target is also invertible on its ground field: if it vanished in the field, it would vanish in every nonzero stalk on the nonempty target. This supplies HasInvertibleExponent for the source-library assertion. Use [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison] to convert finite-constant-value constructibility to finite-stalk constructibility and back. The given interval is equivalent to simultaneous standard t-structure lower and upper bounds. Apply the source assertion of steps 1-2 and take [min(a,c), max(a,c)] for the output interval. This proves the original isBoundedConstructible_rightDerivedLowerStar_of_proper with every binder unchanged.
